summary_en: Dentsu Soken board special committee unanimously recommends shareholders accept public tender offer by LLC VIC (Dentsu Group parent affiliate). Tender intended to be followed by stock consolidation to make Dentsu Soken wholly owned by VIC and Dentsu Group. Committee conducted 19 meetings (approx. 28 hours) from June 5 to August 28, 2026, affirming transaction purpose, pricing fairness, procedural integrity, and shareholder protection.
title_en: (Supplemental) Notice Regarding Board Approval Opinion and Shareholder Application Recommendation for Public Tender Offer by LLC VIC for Dentsu Soken Stock
translation_en_brief: This is a supplemental disclosure (追加) by Dentsu Soken dated 26 August 2026 notifying shareholders that missing attachments to an earlier tender-offer endorsement announcement are being filed. The document includes an advisory opinion (答申書) from the company's special committee of independent directors affirming their unanimous recommendation that shareholders tender into a public offer by LLC VIC (a Dentsu Group affiliate). The committee examined four core matters: (1) legitimacy and rationality of the transaction, including whether it enhances enterprise value; (2) fairness and appropriateness of pricing and terms; (3) procedural integrity; and (4) fairness to minority shareholders. The special committee conducted 19 meetings totalling approximately 28 hours between 5 June and 28 August 2026. The transaction is structured as a tender offer to be followed by stock consolidation (株式併合) to make Dentsu Soken wholly owned by LLC VIC and Dentsu Group. The advisory confirms that the committee found the transaction justified, pricing fair, procedures sound, and the offer fair to public shareholders. Full particulars of the tender (share count, price, timeline) are not disclosed in this excerpt; the filing refers to an earlier comprehensive announcement.
